title: Confirm a Web Terminal request in MetaMask
description: Terminal helper: with signer=extension, wait for MetaMask's side panel/notification to show the dapp request, capture it, check the typed-data primary type for signatures, and approve it as the user. With signer=injected it does nothing (the strict wallet answers in the harness).

choose.intent: Only the MetaMask extension shows a confirmation; the injected wallet answers in the harness

metamask_prompt.intent: Hold until MetaMask presents the dapp's ask to the user

capture_request.intent: Keep a picture of what MetaMask asked the user to approve

choose_kind.intent: Check the signed message type only for signature requests

assert_primary_type.intent: Confirm MetaMask shows the expected typed-data message before the user signs

approve.intent: Approve the request in MetaMask as the user

signer.description: extension: the real MetaMask extension confirms every wallet request (acceptance mode). injected: the strict test wallet signs in the harness (fast mode).

kind.description: connect: account permission; signature: typed-data signature.

primary_type.description: Expected EIP-712 primary type shown for signature requests.
